body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose Acid, Cold or Lightning when declaring. On success, deal 1 Damage of that type and move the target 1 unit sideways.

surges.html: The target is Distracted until the start of your next turn after a hit.

rider.title: Chaos Thread
rider.html: Gain a Chaos Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: change its Damage type to Fire, Cold, Lightning, Acid, Force or Arcane. Conditions do not change.
